en.app.description: Turn a Guitar Pro tab into an MP4 with a moving playhead. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
en.app.title: sonotas – Guitar Pro tabs to video
en.export.done.title: Your video is ready
en.export.failed.retry: Try again, or turn off Fast export under Output.
en.export.failed.title: Couldn’t export the video.
en.export.label: Export
en.export.unsupported.body: Export needs the WebCodecs video encoder. Open sonotas in a recent Chrome or Edge.
en.export.unsupported.title: This browser can’t export video.
en.file.error.title: Couldn’t open that file.
en.frame.aspect.free.hint: Any size, in px at 1080p. The notation keeps its size; the frame shows more or less of it.
en.frame.aspect.portrait.hint: Portrait, for Shorts, Reels and TikTok.
en.frame.at.track.ahead.hint: {n}% across, leaving more of what is coming in view.

en.frame.only_bars: {n, plural, one {Show only this bar} other {Show only these # bars}}
en.frame.playhead.glide.hint: The playhead sweeps through each bar in time.

en.frame.run_past: Keep the playhead in place past the song's ends
en.frame.size.line.hint: Larger notation shows fewer bars at once.
en.frame.size.page.hint: Larger notation fits fewer bars on each line.

en.frame.spacing.wide.hint: Notes spread out, so each bar reads more easily.
en.frame.steady: Steady speed through busy and sparse passages
en.frame.transition.cut.hint: The view cuts straight to its new place.
en.frame.transition.hint: How long the view takes to move over.
en.frame.transition.track.cut.hint: The view cuts to repeats and jumps.
en.frame.transition.track.hint: How the view moves over to repeats and jumps.
en.frame.turn_early.bar: Turn a bar early, so what comes next is in view
en.frame.turn_early.line: Turn a line early, so what comes next is in view
en.frame.view.bar.centred.hint: The view moves once per bar, keeping the bars centred.
en.frame.view.bar.hint: The view moves once per bar.
en.frame.view.bar.page.hint: The view moves once per line.
en.frame.view.screen.hint: The view holds still, then turns a whole screen.
en.frame.view.screen.page.hint: The view holds a screenful of lines, then turns the page.
en.frame.view.track.hint: The view moves all the time, keeping the playhead in place.
en.header.link.label: Copy a link to these settings
en.header.open.label: Open a tab…
en.header.open.tip: Guitar Pro (.gp, .gpx, .gp3–5) or MusicXML. Or drop a file anywhere. It stays in your browser.
en.header.reset.label: Reset settings
en.header.reset.tip: Reset every setting to its default
